title: kernel-v1 Kafka event bus budget (v1)
description: Versioned source of truth for the numeric and policy constants that bound the Kafka event publisher (crates/event-bus-kafka). Every Kafka constant the bench harnesses and the Rust fixtures read is anchored here; any number not anchored here is a plan defect. The publisher uses an idempotent producer (acks=all, enable.idempotence=true, bounded in-flight) for at-least-once delivery with declared duplicates only. Per-agent partition ordering is guaranteed by deterministic partition key derivation from cluster/agent identity. Schema-rejected batches route to events.dlq.v1. Agents never see Kafka (control-plane only).

default_broker_count.description: Default number of brokers in the KRaft fixture cluster. The bench harness reads this to configure the mock cluster topology. Anchored as bench/schemas/kafka.v1.json#default_broker_count.

acks.description: Producer acks setting. MUST be 'all' for the idempotent producer: every produce request waits for all in-sync replicas to acknowledge before the batch is considered durable. Anchored as bench/schemas/kafka.v1.json#acks.

enable_idempotence.description: Whether the idempotent producer is enabled. MUST be true: the producer assigns a producer ID and sequence numbers per partition, enabling broker-side deduplication of retried batches. Anchored as bench/schemas/kafka.v1.json#enable_idempotence.

max_in_flight_requests.description: Maximum in-flight requests per connection. Kafka's idempotent producer requires this to be <= 5 to guarantee ordering with retries. Anchored as bench/schemas/kafka.v1.json#max_in_flight_requests.

max_retries.description: Maximum retries for transient produce failures (leader election, network blips). The idempotent producer retries indefinitely by default (i32::MAX). Anchored as bench/schemas/kafka.v1.json#max_retries.

produce_timeout_ms.description: Produce request timeout in milliseconds. A batch that times out remains in the outbox; no ACK is sent. Anchored as bench/schemas/kafka.v1.json#produce_timeout_ms.

max_queue_depth.description: Maximum local producer queue depth before backpressure. When the queue is full, new batches are rejected with QueueFull and remain in the outbox for retry. Anchored as bench/schemas/kafka.v1.json#max_queue_depth.

topic_events.description: The primary event topic. All event batches are published here. Anchored as bench/schemas/kafka.v1.json#topic_events.

topic_dlq.description: The dead-letter queue topic. Batches rejected by downstream consumers due to schema incompatibility are routed here. Anchored as bench/schemas/kafka.v1.json#topic_dlq.

default_partition_count.description: Default number of partitions for the events topic. Per-agent ordering is guaranteed by deterministic partition key derivation (SHA-256 of cluster/agent identity mod partition count). Anchored as bench/schemas/kafka.v1.json#default_partition_count.

delivery_semantics.description: Delivery semantics. At-least-once with declared duplicates only. No cross-session exactly-once claim. All duplicates are declared via the idempotent producer's deduplication mechanism. Anchored as bench/schemas/kafka.v1.json#delivery_semantics.

fixture_min_precision_and_recall.description: Minimum precision and recall the publisher fixture corpus must achieve. Every partition ordering, idempotent retry, ACK ordering, DLQ routing, and queue full case must be covered. Anchored as bench/schemas/kafka.v1.json#fixture_min_precision_and_recall.
